This repository is the One Small Engineering hub. Status lives in `projects/registry.json` on `main` and changes only through PRs with evidence (`npm run check` must pass). Never merge, record approval, or mark a gate verified without a separate verifier's own `pass` evidence; Joshua Small is the only approver. Registry sync in `scripts/sync/` is deterministic and makes no AI calls. To assess a project follow `agents/project-assessor.md` (assessor-spec: 1); to onboard one follow `agents/onboard-project.md` (onboard-spec: 1).
